observed.caption: A large tree with thick intertwined trunk and hanging aerial roots stands in a grassy open area with a fence and distant city buildings in the background.
observed.description: A massive tree with a thick, gnarled trunk covered in intertwined aerial roots dominates the center of the frame, its wide branches and dense green foliage spreading across the top and sides. Numerous long, thin aerial roots hang down from the branches and trunk. The ground around the base is a mix of bare brown soil and patches of green grass and low leafy undergrowth extending to the left and right. To the left in the mid-background a long gray metal picket fence runs along the edge of the vegetation, with another smaller tree visible behind it. To the right an open grassy field slopes gently toward a cluster of tall modern buildings on the distant horizon under a bright sky visible through gaps in the canopy. The lighting is natural daylight with sunlight filtering through the leaves.
